title: Before this meeting is recorded
paragraphs: This meeting will be recorded. Everyone listed as an attendee has to agree before the recording is processed.
The recording is stored on Cloudflare R2. To turn it into text, the audio is sent to an outside speech-to-text service: Groq, or ElevenLabs when that engine is chosen.
The written transcript is then sent to an outside AI service to write the summary, decisions and action items: Groq, or Google Gemini when that engine is chosen.
Attendees who enrolled their voice are recognised by matching it against their voiceprint. That matching runs on our own server.
Only the host and the people listed as attendees can see the transcript and summary.
If you do not agree, tell the host. They can remove you from the meeting before it is recorded.
